输入必须是 JSON 对象。: Input must be a JSON object.
只接受 lab、p、q；基态和算符选择使用已经返回的数据。: Only lab, p and q are accepted; state and operator selections use the data already returned.
p 和 q 必须为非负整数且 p+q≤4；不接受布尔值、小数或字符串。: p and q must be nonnegative integers with p+q<=4; booleans, decimals and strings are not accepted.
交错图样数等于表示维数: The number of interlacing patterns equals the representation dimension
全部基态满足六条交错约束: Every basis state satisfies all six interlacing constraints
内容非负且总数固定: Contents are nonnegative and have a fixed total
内容差与两个 Cartan 对角元一致: Content differences agree with both Cartan diagonal entries
升降算符互为转置: Raising and lowering operators are transpose pairs
Cartan 与根算符满足基本对易关系: Cartan and root operators satisfy the basic commutators
每个非零矩阵元连接规定的权差: Every nonzero matrix element has the prescribed weight shift
二阶 Casimir 等于表示的标量值: The quadratic Casimir equals the representation's scalar value
固定八维伴随表示：同一表示中的两个零权基态可有不同的升算符作用。: Fixed eight-dimensional adjoint representation: two zero-weight basis states within one representation can have different raising-operator actions.
本比较独立于上方输入。它比较一个八维表示内部的基态，不是张量积中的 8s 与 8: This comparison is independent of the input above. It compares basis states within one octet, not the outer-multiplicity copies 8s and 8a in a tensor product.
采用现有 CG 核心的正交归一 GT 基底；顶行固定为 (p+q,q,0)。: The orthonormal GT basis is shared with the existing CG core; its top row is fixed to (p+q,q,0).
按 (H1+H2,H1,a,b,c) 降序排列，所有矩阵、列向量与权图共用此顺序: Descending order of (H1+H2,H1,a,b,c) is shared by every matrix, column vector and weight diagram.
E12 与 E23 的非零升算符系数取非负实数；共轭三维基底为 (s̄,−d̄,: Nonzero raising coefficients of E12 and E23 are nonnegative real numbers; the conjugate triplet basis is (s̄,−d̄,ū). Rephasing the basis changes some matrix-element signs.
算符左乘列向量，第 j 列是第 j 个归一基态的像；Eij 不是有限的幺正群操作: Operators multiply column vectors on the left; column j is the image of normalized basis state j. Eij is not a finite unitary group operation.
T3、T8 是 Cartan 本征值坐标；权图不是实空间、动量空间或能级图。: T3 and T8 are Cartan eigenvalue coordinates; a weight diagram is not real space, momentum space or an energy-level diagram.
原始列向量不重新归一化，范数平方不是跃迁概率；零输出向量不等于零权基态。: Raw columns are not renormalized, and their squared norms are not transition probabilities. A zero output vector is not a zero-weight basis state.
u、d、s、I、Y 在此是表示标签；未指定物理模型时不赋予粒子味、晶体轨道或空间: Here u, d, s, I and Y are representation labels. Without a specified physical model, they are not assigned particle-flavor, crystal-orbital or spatial-direction meanings.
只构造 p+q≤4 的十五个 SU(3) 不可约表示，不构造任意 SU(N) 或: The scope is the fifteen SU(3) irreps with p+q<=4, rather than arbitrary SU(N) representations or new CG change-of-basis matrices.
① 先检查图样是否合法: 1. Check that the pattern is allowed
顶行确定表示，六条交错不等式筛选允许的 GT 基态。: The top row specifies the representation; six interlacing inequalities select its allowed GT basis states.
② 从行和读出三个内容数: 2. Read three contents from row sums
逐层行和之差给出内容数，总数固定为 p+2q。: Differences of successive row sums give the contents, whose total is fixed to p+2q.
③ 内容差给出权与 Cartan 坐标: 3. Read weights and Cartan coordinates from content differences
先求两个整数权，再换成 T3、T8 及 I、I3、Y。: First find the two integer weights, then express T3, T8 and I, I3, Y.
④ 用矩阵的一列读取算符作用: 4. Read an operator action from one matrix column
完整列向量保留全部目标基态及精确系数；权相同的基态仍保留各自索引。: The complete column retains every target basis state and exact coefficient; states of the same weight retain distinct indices.
⑤ 比较同权但不同的基态: 5. Compare distinct states of the same weight
固定八维例子用 E12 和 E23 区分两个零权基态；一个升算符给出零并不表示输: The fixed octet uses E12 and E23 to distinguish two zero-weight states; annihilation by one raising operator does not make the input a zero vector.
改变表示后需要重新运行；基态和算符选择只浏览本次计算的完整结果。: Run again after changing the representation; state and operator selections only browse the complete current result.
相同权点的全部成员都保留；图上重合不能代替基态相等或能量简并的判断。: All members of a coincident weight point are retained; graphical coincidence does not establish equality of basis states or energy degeneracy.
所有精确式、数值和 LaTeX 均由同一 SymPy 对象生成；数值只用于显示与: Every exact expression, numerical value and LaTeX string is generated from the same SymPy object; numerical values are used only for display and plotting.
